reason: I have to replace lost volume and I pay nothing until I see 15 real companies in my niche and three free meetings, so the worst case is I lose a few hours. I will take the free list first, and only if those names are buyers I actually know are good will I sign the pilot.
objection: I paid before for slides and promises. Your proof is one logistics client, not a wholesaler like me, and 45 meetings means nothing if they are tyre-kickers. I also doubt that a cold email in the local language works for distribution buyers who buy on relationships and price.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 companies on the free list are generic names any intern could pull from a directory, or the qualified-meeting definition gets watered down when we sign it, I walk away.
